title: ID0402881-DC/Si-D/EE - [V6nFZ1] - No meter values from AC socket
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Sicharge D's AC socket not sending correct meter values after user stops the transaction form the car.
OCPP gets meter value 0 kWh charged and is not billed for the energy they charged.
Root cause: NA
Solution:  FW Update
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: No

Active
